bug_verification.original_issue: John Collins showing stale/incorrect stats (old game logs from Oct 2025 instead of March 2026)
bug_verification.root_cause: BDL API returns games in ASCENDING order (oldest first), app was only fetching 15 games, and DNP games were included in averages
fix_applied: 1. Increased fetch_player_game_logs limit from 15 to 100 games
2. Added sorting by date descending (most recent first)
3. Added _filter_played_games() to exclude DNP games from L5/L10/hit rate calculations
